edges.carries: the amount the user paid for the iPhone
the claimed VAT shortfall, the fee, and the contact details the request came from
the amount the request says is owed
whether Apple confirms the shortfall and fee are genuine
the computed 19.5% VAT difference plus the 5.29 fee
whether the computed and requested amounts match
the user's approval and the confirmed amount

nodes.name: ReadPurchaseRecord
nodes.role: read the amount the user paid for the iPhone

nodes.name: ReadPaymentRequest
nodes.role: read the payment request the user received, including the amount it claims is owed and the contact it came from

nodes.name: VerifyRequestWithApple
nodes.role: confirm through Apple's official support channel that the claimed VAT shortfall and fee are genuine

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: calculate 19.5% of the amount paid plus the stated 5.29 fee

nodes.name: CheckAgainstRequest
nodes.role: compare the computed amount with the amount the payment request asks for

nodes.name: AskUserConfirmation
nodes.role: present the verified amount and the verification result to the user and ask whether to proceed

nodes.name: SendPayment
nodes.role: send the user-approved amount to Apple

nodes.name: RecordPayment
nodes.role: store the payment reference and status
